newsitem.title: ALGERIA: Algerian wholesale prices rise 8 pct in H1 1996.
newsitem.headline: Algerian wholesale prices rise 8 pct in H1 1996.

text.p: Wholesale prices in Algeria rose at an average annual rate of eight percent in the first half of 1996, the National Statistics Office said.
The report, carried by the official Algerian news agency APS on Monday, gave no comparative figures for the 1995 period.
The rise was made up of an overall increase of 3.1 percent in the second quarter of the 1996, following one of 15.7 percent in the first quarter, compared with the same periods last year.
Wholesale food and farm product prices rose 5.36 percent in the second quarter of 1996.

Heating products and lubricants rose an average 41.2 percent in the first half (rpt first half) of 1996 compared with the same six months last year, while building material prices in the first six months of 1996 fell 6.1 percent over the same 1995 period.
Clothes, textiles and leather items rose 0.45 percent in the second quarter (rpt second quarter) of 1996, the report said.
